mechanism: Lopinavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) may increase methimazole metabolism or alter its hepatic clearance, potentially affecting antithyroid efficacy; additionally, both drugs carry risk of agranulocytosis and hepatotoxicity.
action: Monitor thyroid function tests and CBC regularly; adjust methimazole dose based on TSH/free T4 levels; educate patient on agranulocytosis symptoms.
